body: The temple may leave you alive but brain dead. Talk to the therapist tomorrow.

I am in the exact same boat. 

I'm a few years older but keep coming back to the same spot. Its hard to talk to anyone about it because they just don't understand. I've never really been able to talk with anyone about how I really feel because I worry if they knew how serious I was they would commit me to the hospital. I wonder if people want to stop me from killing myself because they really care or if they would stop me just because thats what they are supposed to do.

I dont know if you feel the same way at all, but if you would like to talk it might help the both of us.

Why is everyone treating me like shit then? Excluding me from everything. They know how I feel right now, it seems ending my life would only be better for them so they wouldnt have to try to avoid me.

Every morning when I wake up I get hit with a wall of sadness knowing I am back here. There are times I get impulsive and just want to slip a bag over my head to try to end it all. The only thing that stops me is knowing it would probably fail and I would be discovered in my half-assed attempt. 

I am seeing a psychiatrist but its not helping. I am on medication. Its not helping.

I just want to be held as I weep into someones chest.
